tei:div.tei:p: bla ma'i srog 'khor dar dkar po la byin rlabs can gyi rdzas kyis bri ba ni: lte bar bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa: zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can gyi thugs kar ā+oṃ: de rgyab mu khyud la: dbu'i steng nas sngags mgo phyir bstan la: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥdza: ces pa bri: de rgyab pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbu'i steng nas rim par: ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru tsit+ta hring: zhes bri: de rgyab mu khyud la: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ swā hā: zhes bri: de rgyab mu khyud la: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dz+nyā na sid+dhi: dharmā sid+dhi: a kra sid+dhi: ā yuḥsid+dhi: puṇ+ye sid+dhi: ba su sid+dhi: khe dha sid+dhi: sarba sid+dhi pha la aṃ ku sha dzaḥwa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ swā hā: de rgyab mu khyud la: a ā: i ī: u ū: ṛ ṝ: l̥ l̥̄: e ai: o au: aṃ a: ka kha ga gha nga: tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa: sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa: ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tun+te ṣān ta thā ga to h+ya ba data te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa: zhes pa bri'o: yi dam srog 'khor dar dmar po la rin po che'i khu bas bri ba ni: dbus su rta mgrin gri gug thod khrag can gyi thugs kar āḥbri: de rgyab mu khyud la: dbu yi steng nas 'go bzung ste: ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥdza: zhes bri: de rgyab mu khyud la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi steng nas rim par: ā+oṃ ha ya grī wa tsit+ta hring hring: zhes pa bri:

de rgyab mu khyud la: ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta ha ya grī wa: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ swā hā: zhes bri: de rgyab mu khyud la: ā+oṃ dhe wa badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba: ra tsa hri ya: dz+nyā na sid+dhi: zhes sogs bla ma'i srog 'khor dang 'dra: de rgyab mu khyud la: ā li kā li rten 'brel snying po rnams bri'o: mkha' 'gro'i srog 'khor dar mthing nag la pad+ma rak+ta dang sin+dhu ras bri ba ni: rdo rje phag mo spyi ltar lte bar bri thugs kar hūm̐ bri: phyi'i mu khyud la: dbu'i steng nas: ā+oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī: kro tī kā lī dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ phaṭa: tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥdza: zhes bri: de rgyab mu khyud 'dab brgyad la: ā+oṃ badz+ra bhā ra hī tsit+ta hring: zhes 'bru re bri: de rgyab mu khyud la: ā+oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai: badz+ra bhā rā hī: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ swā hā: zhes bri:

dpe la lar/ de rgyab gsum ga la mu khyud gnyis 'grigs phra mo re 'dug /ces pa'ang snang*/ mchan/ de rgyab mu khyud la: oṃ sarba dhā ki nī: badz+ra bhā rā hī kro tī kā lī ha ri ni sa: dz+nyā na sid+dhi: dharmā sid+dhi sogs gong ltar bri: de rgyab mu khyud la ā li kā li ye dharmā rnams bri'o: thams cad lha'i dbu steng nas 'go brtsam ste sngags mgo phyir bstan la g.yas skor du bri'o: me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi: de'i rgyab tu pad+ma 'dab brgyad: de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs drug rtsibs mchan la dga' ba 'khyil pa re re: de rgyab mu khyud yangs pa gcig la:me long gi ri mo: sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal pho brang pad ma 'dab bzhi: de rgyab 'dab ma brgyad du snang: maṅga laṃ:
